_about.note: Evidence category of every GameBalance field and constant used by the Prompt 07 energy and life-support model. Categories: physics (standard science, no register id), S08 (ISS ECLSS, NASA page), fiction scaled from S09 (MOXIE on Mars; colony-size unit is fiction), S01/S02 (Mars constants), balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure). Source ids refer to docs/source_register.md.

WATER_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 2 H2O -> 2 H2 + O2: 36 g water gives 32 g oxygen, 1.126 kg (= L) of water per kg O2. Constant, not tuning.

HYDROGEN_PER_KG_WATER.note: 2 g hydrogen in 18 g water; hydrogen from electrolysis is vented (ledger hydrogen_vented_kg).

CO2_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 2 CO2 -> 2 CO + O2: 88 g CO2 per 32 g O2 (ledger co2_intake_kg).

CO_KG_PER_KG_O2.note: 56 g CO vented per 32 g O2 (ledger co_vented_kg).

GAS_R.note: Gas constant 8.314 J/(mol K) for p = m / M x R x T / V.

battery_kwh_start.note: 560 kWh (was 180). Fiction 2080 battery bank; chosen so 3 sols with no action never empty it.

wastewater_l_start.note: 20 L of used water waiting at arrival. New store.

oxygen_kg_start.note: 60 kg in the oxygen reserve tanks (unchanged; now the reserve, not the cabin air).

n2_reserve_kg_start.note: 60 kg nitrogen for topping up cabin air. New store.

solar_kw_peak.note: 100 kW for all 12 trackers at noon, clean, tracking, default sky (was 60). Fiction 2080 array; not a NASA figure and not the old demo's 90/128/140 kW.

dust_tau_default.note: 0.5. Default dust in the air (optical depth). No measured dust opacity product is in the register yet (register section 10); the weather milestone will drive state.dust_tau.

dust_tau_factor.note: 0.6. Mechanism: dust in the air blocks sunlight, output x exp(-factor x tau), normalised to 1 at the default. The strength is tuning.

dust_deposit_per_sol.note: 0.02 of each panel per sol at the default sky, scaled by dust_tau / default. S18 (InSight dust losses) is SEARCH-ONLY and is not used for this number.

panel_dust_start.note: 0.45 on every panel at arrival (part of the arrival restoration).

cleaner_condition_start.note: 0: the automatic cleaner has failed at arrival.

battery_charge_efficiency.note: 0.9: energy stored = energy in x 0.9; the rest is ledgered as battery_loss_kwh.

zone_load_kw.note: Room lights per zone: Greenhouse 9 (grow lights, unchanged), Hangar bay 1, Dome plaza 0.8, Garden dome 0.8, Exterior 0.6, Command Room 0.4, Med Bay 0.4, Life Support 0.3, Power Room 0.3 kW (others were 2-5 kW).

critical_light_zones.note: Life Support, Power Room, Airlock, Med Bay: their lights count as base load and are shed last.

equipment_min_condition.note: Equipment below condition 0.5 does not run.

water_l_per_hour.note: 0.25 L per active astronaut per game hour, drinking and washing (was 0.16).

water_to_wastewater.note: 0.85 of used water returns as wastewater; the rest leaves in breath and sweat.

water_reserve_l.note: 100 L protected for drinking; allocations never take the store below it.

recycler_l_per_hour.note: 3 L of wastewater cleaned per game hour.

recycler_recovery.note: 0.90: ISS water recovery 'about 90 percent' (NASA ECLSS page). ISS evidence, not Mars evidence.

recycler_good_condition.note: Below condition 0.8 the recycler makes water of quality condition / 0.8.

electrolyser_min_quality.note: The electrolyser stops below water quality 0.9.

wastewater_warn_fraction.note: Warn at 80 % of the wastewater tank.

electrolysis_o2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.2 kg O2 per game hour. Mechanism from S08 (oxygen generation by electrolysis of water); the rate is tuning.

electrolysis_kwh_per_kg_o2.note: 6 kWh per kg O2, above the physics minimum of about 4.1 kWh/kg (water splitting energy). Tuning.

co2_unit_o2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.15 kg O2 per game hour, about 12.5 x MOXIE's best 12 g/h. MOXIE showed the mechanism on Mars; a colony-size unit is fiction.

co2_unit_kwh_per_kg_o2.note: 20 kWh per kg O2. Not from S09 (the register holds no MOXIE power figure). Chosen higher than electrolysis: no water, more power.

cabin_volume_m3.note: 400 m3, one pressurised volume for the habitat (fiction).

o2_setpoint_kpa.note: 21 kPa, Earth-like cabin (about 109.6 kg O2 in 400 m3 at 295 K by the ideal gas law).

regulator_kg_per_hour.note: Most O2 or N2 the regulator releases per game hour, each gas: 3 kg.

scrubber_co2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.4 kg CO2 per game hour with the fans running. Mechanism from S08 (CO2 removed with molecular sieves); the rate is tuning.

scrubber_floor_kpa.note: The scrubber does not pull CO2 below 0.1 kPa.

fans_off_scrubber_share.note: Without the cabin fans the scrubber works at 25 %.

co2_danger_kpa.note: 1.0 kPa: above it CO2 harms the crew.

o2_low_kpa.note: 16 kPa: below it low oxygen harms the crew.

airlock_cycle_loss_kg.note: 2 kg of cabin air lost per airlock cycle, mixed in proportion.

oxygen_kg_per_hour.note: 0.035 kg O2 breathed per active astronaut per game hour (unchanged).

co2_kg_per_hour.note: 0.042 kg CO2 breathed out per active astronaut per game hour.

suit_o2_capacity_kg.note: 0.4 kg tank: about 11.4 game hours outside at 0.035 kg/h.

health_loss_per_hour_low_o2.note: Up to 40 health per game hour, scaled by how far cabin O2 is below o2_low_kpa (replaces health_loss_per_hour_no_oxygen).

health_loss_per_hour_co2.note: Up to 20 per game hour, scaled by how far CO2 is above co2_danger_kpa.

health_loss_per_hour_no_air.note: 25 per game hour outside without air (suit off or tank empty); no instant death.

health_loss_per_hour_no_water.note: 6 per game hour, scaled by the unmet share (unchanged).

health_loss_per_hour_no_food.note: 3 per game hour, scaled by the unmet share (unchanged).

_removed.note: Removed placeholder fields: water_recycle_fraction, oxygen_kg_per_hour_generated, oxygen_generation_kw, health_loss_per_hour_no_oxygen (replaced by the recycler, the two oxygen processes and health_loss_per_hour_low_o2). SOL_HOURS (S02) and MARS_GRAVITY (S01) stay in GameConfig.
